name: Seek Redemption!
objectiveText: Collect 3 Fel Cones and give them to Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar. Fel Cone  ( 3 )

comments.body:
I had trouble finding them at first. I found one and waited there, but it didnt respawn. Then I found one at 59,56 that did respawn really quick.  For those w/out coords its on the opposite side of the tree thats by the guy.

So I think that if the one you find doesn't respawn in 1 min, you should find another. Hope this helps.
You can find the Fel Cones around Zenn Foulhoof or even further around Starbreeze Village.  Try to look around the bases of very large trees.  Some coordinates to try are 58, 55 and 59, 56.

Fel Cones are sometimes very easy and sometimes very hard for players to notice. They are actually fairly plentiful, and every large tree usually has one or two beneath it somewhere. They look like small mounds with green smoke coming out the top. They are small and easily blend in with the background if you aren't careful about looking for them.

But rest assured, they are basically everywhere in Teldrassil. If you haven't found your's, it's simply a matter of looking a little more carefully. The tree right next to Zenn has one around the opposite side, to get started. (Assuming nobody else grabbed it in the last couple minutes.)
